decisions.statement: A start is placed by how far into its piece the sentence begins.
A sentence is taken to run at an even rate across the piece with that sentence.
As many durations as pieces are given or nothing is answered.
A sentence starting past the last piece is left unmarked.
A reading begun partway has the marks of the whole rather than of the part.
Durations nobody measured are guessed from how many characters a piece holds.
Nothing here listens to the audio this module marks.

definition: when each sentence starts, worked out from how long each rendered piece runs
